sources.title: On the light from the sky, its polarization and colour

claims.text: Sunlight contains all the colours of visible light.

quotes.quote: FIXTURE: sunlight is made of all the colours of the rainbow

claims.text: Air molecules scatter short (blue) wavelengths far more strongly than long (red) ones.

quotes.quote: FIXTURE: scattering intensity is inversely proportional to the fourth power of the wavelength

claims.text: Blue light (~450 nm) is scattered roughly 5–6 times more than red light (~700 nm).
